about.title: About Gold Knight Tech
about.subtitle: Vancouver's trusted smart home partner since 2014
about.p1: Gold Knight Tech brings professional-grade home automation to homeowners across Greater Vancouver. We design and install comprehensive smart home systems integrating security, lighting, climate, and entertainment.
about.p2: Our team specializes in alarm systems (DSC, Vista, Honeywell), home networking, audio/video distribution, and custom automation. Every installation is tailored to each home's unique needs.
about.p3: We use quality equipment, provide professional installation, and deliver ongoing support for years of flawless performance.
